Powering the Future with Integrity and Excellence

Founded in 1999, Portland Natural Gas Transmission System (PNGTS) has grown from a regional operator to a key player in the North American energy market.

Contact Us

Delivering energy safely, economically, and reliably every minute of every day

Building a Reliable Energy Future for New England and Beyond

At Portland Natural Gas Transmission System (PNGTS), we are committed to creating a dependable and sustainable energy future for New England and beyond. Our state-of-the-art infrastructure and strategic connections ensure a consistent and secure supply of natural gas to the region. By prioritizing safety, regulatory compliance, and environmental stewardship, we play a vital role in meeting the current and future energy needs of our communities. Through continuous innovation and a customer-centric approach, we are dedicated to supporting economic growth, enhancing energy reliability, and contributing to a sustainable future for generations to come.

OUR VISION

To be the most trusted partner for our customers, meeting the current and future energy needs of the New England region.

Our leadership team is comprised of seasoned professionals with extensive experience in the energy sector

Their strategic vision and innovative approach drive PNGTS forward, ensuring we remain at the forefront of the industry. Under their guidance, PNGTS has achieved significant milestones and will continue to set high standards in operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

Operations

PNGTS operates an extensive network of pipelines and facilities across New England. Our infrastructure is designed to deliver natural gas efficiently and safely, meeting the diverse needs of utility companies, industrial users, and power generation facilities. With a capacity of nearly 460,000 Dth/d, our robust infrastructure ensures a reliable supply of natural gas, supporting the region's energy demands.

  • State-of-the-art facilities that ensure efficient and reliable natural gas transportation.

  • Facilities positioned to optimize delivery and meet regional energy needs.

  • Rigorous safety standards and continuous investment in training and technology.
